column1: # G3 phase 6: the trim reporter -- redundant map entries as paths
# (docs/capability-review/g3-subsumption-evolution.md). Columns:
# name<TAB>trim<TAB>src<TAB>expect, where expect is the report as a
# JSON object ({redundant, verdict}); verdicts are clean | redundant |
# error (a source that does not stand up on its own).
# The test is EVALUATE-AND-COMPARE per candidate entry: re-parse,
# delete the entry from the parsed tree, evaluate, compare canons --
# which subsumes the spread-implied case and is honest about
# references, templates and duplicate-key merges. Report-only:
# rewriting needs G7's format-preserving patch surface. Granularity is
# the parsed MAP ENTRY: duplicate spellings of one key merge at parse
# and are one entry; list elements are not candidates (removing one
# shifts every later index). A child of a redundant parent is not
# reported separately.
# Every expectation was obtained by the parity probe (AGENTS.md).
trim-spread-implied
trim-ref-clean
trim-plain-clean
trim-constraint-spread-clean
trim-broken-error
trim-multi-redundant
trim-dup-key-granularity
trim-list-inner-map
trim-spread-changes-doc
# A child of a redundant parent is not reported separately
# (trim-nested-covered-once: $.a.m.b covers $.a.m.b.c).
trim-unparseable-error
trim-nested-covered-once
